name: Mouse hover and click in the in-game UI
body: Dean, 2026-10-30: yes to mouse support in the Chaos/Cosmos in-game UI. Buttons (elements with onPress or onRelease) should take hover and clicks from the mouse as well as keyboard and gamepad focus.

comments.text: Filed before starting, per Dean's standing rule.
Done. Tests pass; the running game was checked under Xvfb (hovering Quit focuses it, clicking Play starts the game).

plan:
- Platform: MouseMoved and the mouse button events carry the pointer's window position (logical points), from SDL's event x/y.
- Game host: track the pointer from platform events (GameHost::handle_event); none while the mouse is captured. Convert to pixels with the window metrics and pass it to the UI with the frame's navigation.
- lantern-chaos-ui: keep the last drawn rects. Moving the pointer over a button focuses it (onFocus); pressing the left button on a button sends onPress and draws :active while held over it; releasing over the same button sends onRelease; releasing elsewhere cancels. A stationary pointer never takes focus from the keyboard.
- Tests in lantern-chaos-ui and an end-to-end click in game-host; screenshot of a hovered button under Xvfb.
- Docs: game-api.md, architecture.md, D-044.

Folded through 2026-10-30T03:00:00.
acceptance_criteria: Hovering a menu button with the mouse focuses it and plays the focus sound
A left click on a button runs its onRelease, same as confirm
Press on one button and release on another does nothing
Keyboard and gamepad navigation work as before
While the mouse is captured (playing), the pointer does nothing to the UI
